Use this review as information, not a grade. You can complete it weekly or monthly and choose one realistic next action.

The schedule is optional and stays local until you explicitly download an ICS file or open Google Calendar.

::: {#values-review-app .skill-app data-practice-app="values-review"}
Loading Values Review…
:::

## Review flexibility as well as follow-through

Notice which thoughts or feelings pulled your attention away from your chosen direction. What helped you return, and what practical barriers need a different plan? A useful next action can be smaller than the one you first imagined.

Additional reflection informed by Russ Harris, [*The Happiness Trap*](https://thehappinesstrap.com/), supplied 33-chapter edition, Chapters 27-32.
